card.name: The end of "unopposed"
card.fires_on: The final piece "posed" in the word "unopposed", mostly in warnings about unopposed estrogens and endometrial cancer risk.

modes.label: Unopposed estrogen
modes.description: "posed" completes "unopposed" before estrogen or estrogens in endometrial cancer warnings.
modes.example: There is an increased risk of endometrial cancer in a woman with a uterus who uses unop<<posed>> estrogens

modes.label: Unopposed receptor or drug action
modes.description: "posed" completes "unopposed" before another drug or receptor effect, such as opioid agonist or alpha receptor.
modes.example: subjecting the patient to high levels of unop<<posed>> opioid agonist as the samidorphan
